exposure: Women who received antibiotics during childbirth
Women who received antibiotics during pregnancy
outcome: Prevalence of antibiotic exposure during pregnancy and childbirth
cohort: Women who gave birth after 23+0 weeks of gestation at a single tertiary center in Germany from January 2020 to March 2021.
finding: The study found a high rate of antibiotic exposure during pregnancy and childbirth, with lower gestational age at birth, higher maternal body mass index, and smoking independently associated with increased use.
